# E0349: a _coalesce's fallback may itself be absent

coalesce's fallback is what the lens uses when the field is absent, so the
fallback itself must always exist: a constant, or a field the source always
has. An optional field may be absent too.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a?: string
	b?: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	c: string
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		c: _coalesce(prev.a, prev.b)
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	c: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0349]: b is optional in v0.0, so it cannot be _coalesce's fallback: the fallback must always exist
 --> history/1.0.thema:7:24
  |
7 |         c: _coalesce(prev.a, prev.b)
  |                              ^^^^
  |
```
